scope: Fixed exploratory building representation follow-up, no outcome-driven parameter search.
primary: Building-weighted same-cohort comparison; old permit context vs fractional building context and context excluding focal building.
composition: One unit per unique building; split equally among unique eligible industries present in that building. Repeated building-industry records contribute once.
same_building: included and excluded variants both reported
models: LR C1 max_iter1500; industry-region-year baseline plus industry interactions with context; no calibration tuning
train: five opening cohorts y-6 through y-2, fully observed365day outcomes
subtype: separate exploratory sensitivity using current recorded category, historical availability unverified
limitations: Building is not a unique storefront. Different floors/shops remain distinct real businesses.
Building keys and coordinates are current snapshot values; historical relocation unknown.
Fractional industry shares reflect building occupancy mix, not store market shares.
Same outcomes inspected in previous experiments; not an untouched test.
Building sample weights change estimand and do not establish causal effects.
